import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd();w=str(lane/'write_lane.py')
def save(n,o):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',w,n],input=json.dumps(o,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
receipts=[]
for p in sorted(lane.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 r=json.loads(p.read_text());receipts.append({'file':p.name,'exit':r['exit'],'killed':r['killed'],'wall_s':r['wall_s'],'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':r['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'affinity':r['affinity'],'child_cpu_cumulative_s':r['child_cpu_cumulative_s']});assert r['exit']==0
save('resource-inventory.json',{'completed_receipts':receipts,'terminal_receipt':'terminal_manifest_35.receipt.json created on synchronous runner completion; exactly excluded from noncircular manifest','fixed_caps':'affinity<=2,childCPU115/supervisor120,AS6GiB,sampled process-group RSS6GiB,deadline130/outer140,arena2','exceptions':'bootstrap and standalone before/after verifier as authorized','native_search_CPU_RSS':'unavailable','sampling':'misses transients; zero sampled RSS not zero actual allocation; separate writer peaks unavailable','universal_cgroup_process_compliance':'not claimed','all_jobs':'synchronously reaped; no background work'})
result=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());assert set(map(int,result))==set(json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'])
assert not json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']
exclusions={'SHA256-MANIFEST.json':'manifest cannot contain its own hash','terminal_manifest_35.receipt.json':'runner writes this after manifest process returns; self command binds manifest-producing code','terminal_manifest_35.output.txt':'runner writes terminal output after manifest process returns'}
files=[]
for p in sorted(lane.rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file():continue
 rel=str(p.relative_to(lane))
 if rel in exclusions:continue
 assert not p.is_symlink()
 b=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
manifest={'scope':'all own-lane files existing at terminal manifest generation, including every previously completed receiptJSON, immutable helpers/plans, inherited denials, lock/hashchain, sources, literals, handoffs and frozen-after','terminal_non_circular_self_exclusions':exclusions,'files':files,'qualified_survivors':0,'accepted_credit':0,'completed_receipt_count':len(receipts),'frozen_after':'PASS12/12'}
save('SHA256-MANIFEST.json',manifest)
for x in files:assert hashlib.sha256((lane/x['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==x['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(files),'completed_receipts_bound':len(receipts),'terminal_exclusions':list(exclusions),'frozen_after':'PASS12/12','survivors':0,'credit':0}))
